productApkPolicy: NO_REBUILD_NO_REINSTALL; previous installed identities remain subject to separate formal preflight
stopPolicy: Basic failure blocks AVI. Each producer once only; no retry/resume/cleanup/overwrite; every residual/temp remains. No product tests or Binder rerun.
stdinCloseGate: Allocated original stdin close must actually return. Exceptions/pending retain actual Job/process/stdin/source/args and refuse collect/transfer_file; no second close or fresh interpreter to clear unknown.
postTimeoutGate: Only observation of original actual close/source/drains/wait and thread return can release resource ownership; original timed-out attempt stays NOT_ADMITTED and must never resume or publish.
launchGate: Absolute regular non-symlink executable preflight; before allocator entry no process/stdin charge, but actual source close still required. Opaque entered constructor failure stays UNKNOWN, no zero-allocation guess from an error.
